newsitem.title: GREECE: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) DROPS GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES THUR.
newsitem.headline: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) DROPS GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES THUR.

text.p: Greek gasoline prices will be lowered by 1.30 drachmas per litre and heating diesel will drop by 3.20 drachmas, effective on Thursday and for one week, Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) said in a statement.
The price of diesel used as transport fuel will go up by 1.10 drachmas per litre.
The price adjustments come after lower world gasoline prices, down by $3.4 per metric tonne, lower diesel prices, down by $10.7 and a dollar/drachma exchange rate.
"Transport diesel prices are going up because of a better quality, low sulfur fuel coming to market. It contains 0.05 percent sulphur, down from 0.2 percent." DEP said.
